items.title: A Zoom Screen-Sharing Bug Let Anyone Take Over Other Devices on a Call
items.summary: Researchers say it took fewer than 20 prompts for a public AI tool to find a flaw (now fixed) allowing anyone on a Zoom call to hijack another participants’ device.
items.author: Lily Hay Newman

items.title: A New Trick Reveals AI Models’ Inner Thoughts
items.summary: Researchers devised a way to extract “reasoning traces” from Claude, GPT, and Gemini. What they found, they say, indicates that some Chinese AI may be trained on leading US models.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
items.summary: Mini human brains are being grown in labs all over the world. Soon, they could outthink neural networks.
items.author: Claire L. Evans

items.title: AI Is Helping Solve the Intricate Genetic Puzzle of Schizophrenia
items.summary: Recent findings provide one of the most detailed pictures to date of the genetic architecture of schizophrenia, opening up new avenues for research into the disorder.
items.author: Jorge Garay
